title: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究

novelty_points.claim: GSAERU模型通过图摘要技术将大规模动态图映射为固定规模的新图，从而解决GNN模型输出无法直接输入到RNN模型中进行训练的问题。
novelty_points.claim_en: The GSAERU model maps large-scale dynamic graphs to fixed-size new graphs via graph summarization technology, thereby solving the problem of GNN model outputs being unable to directly input into RNN models for training.
technical_features: 利用图摘要技术将原图压缩为固定规模的新图
通过图自编码器学习新图的表征
将新图的节点表征聚合得到原图的节点表征
technical_features_en: Compressing the original graph into a fixed-size new graph using graph summarization technology
Learning the representation of the new graph via a graph autoencoder
Aggregating the node representations of the new graph to obtain the node representations of the original graph
